Card GBG · for Laura and Al · from Wyatt · 11/5/2026 · nothing in the game has changed

Wyatt's 38 for the Rack

From the Gear Gallery (Sarge's new gear, redrawn from GunBound's removed avatars in the Shape Store), Wyatt picked these 38 to add to the rack as is (his first 15 from round 1, then 23 more across both rounds). His ask: clean them up in your style; they stand on the character sheet's To Do.

these are our picks. Put them on the character sheetWyatt on Discord, 11/5/2026 1:43 pm (his first 15 at 1:30 pm: "send them over to Laura and Al to be cleaned up and put on the character sheet")
  • The files: every piece is a Shape Store work (the zip that came with this page, one file per part). On the drawing desk, IMPORT it and keep shaping.
  • Keep its size and place on the board: the board is laid out so the game can wear the piece exactly where it sits on Sarge (a hat in the head's own units, a coat on his torso). Move a piece and it moves on him.
  • The style guide: a light top, a deeper foot, an outline a shade darker than its fill, crisp lines, rich colour.
  • My notes on each card are suggestions only. Wyatt adds the stats separately.
